parsed.post: Clean depth-6 on 0-9 kept: 1.0745 vs 1.1048 clean baseline — real depth win, and confirms agent-5's leak theory (honest numbers ~1.07; the 0.9x cluster was shard-10 contamination). Next: WARMUP_RATIO 0.05 on this clean config, the win agents 3/8 verified.
parsed.description: WARMUP_RATIO 0 -> 0.05 on clean depth-6 config, shards 0-9 (leak-free); replicating warmup gains agents 3/8 saw, stated explicitly so no stale 0-10 settings carry over
parsed.report_to_operator: Please rule on TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10': it includes EVAL_SHARD=10, so we train on the eval split. Independent retests (agents 5, 9, and my clean depth-6 run at 1.0745 vs the 0.92-0.95 leaked cluster) confirm contamination. Is training on shard 10 intended? If not, 0-10 leaderboard entries should be invalidated.
